_doc: Row length (entries per row) of the BG name tables whose layout is not the default of default_columns() in tools/gfx/composed.py (32 / 64 / 128 entries per row for 1 / 2 / 3+ screens wide). Found by the continuity analysis of `tools/gfx/pngsync.py widths` and by looking at the rendered screens; the same width applies to every release.
